title: This app is by far the best holiday tracker
content:
This app has the perfect combination of features to make it stand out against the rest. 
*Automatic GPS tracking (without much battery usage)
*suggested posts based on photos and main stops
*beautiful interface with the map and timeline below
*making reels out of the content
*turning it into a book at the end! I have gotten all my family onto this and buy them books for their birthdays.
*and now.. AI trip suggestions of where to go which is actually better at knowing me than I know myself. It uses your past trips to make suggestions and it’s spot on! 
 
Great Segway to some suggestions: 
- can the reels show the map as well please? Like those little map animations you see in YouTube videos. 
- can the app automatically draft posts from past trips based on your photos. At the moment I have to go back and forth between my photos app and polarsteps to find out where I went. 
- Since writing my last suggestion, you can now join a trip with someone which is so great but itd be great if I could have admin permission for my parents trips and then you could surprise them with the book as well. So I can help them write posts but the app wouldn’t track my location. 
- automatically add posts from social media. And even better, get social media posts from travel trips in the past and create a polarsteps trip and therefore a travel book from past trips using social media. This would be amazing. 
- Being able to follow people to different degrees e.g. get immediate notifications for some people and not for others. 
- be able to comment on the overall trip and not just the individual posts. 
- be an admin of a trip for someone else so you can write information an add photos for them. 

That’s all for now. Thanks for making a great app. I mean it. I’ll do whatever I can to support it to keep it up-to-date 😊

title: Slow response and uses a lot of data.
content:
My experience is with an iPhone 13, travelling across Europe. The 2 biggest issues I have with this app are; very slow to respond and does use quite a bit of data. The response time is deeply frustrating. If you are on a bus, train or other moving object and want to take a picture, when you open the app and try to add another step, it can take 20-30 seconds to respond - meaning that shot is no longer there. I have also experienced it freezing when the camera is open and it can take a long time to respond and take the shot. ‘A long time’ can be measured by my wife's frustration at me constantly standing still holding my phone up whilst looking silly. Or the tour guide constantly telling me to catch up to the group. I have had to use just the regular camera to take a picture and then upload it; but that then makes me ask why use this app? 
The data use is also annoying. You expect most people who are travelling not to have unlimited data like you do at home. For me, the app used 2Mb data in 2 weeks, which was publishing steps for one day and then only saving the steps as drafts to be uploaded by wifi. That was all the data my overseas plan gave me for a month so I had to buy more. The performance seems to have slowed with more steps and photos. I am using this app to share my trip with friends at home, so am loading a lot if steps and photo’s. 
It also randomly reboots, normally at an inopportune time. Tracking can be inaccurate - if travelling a return route one leg will be different to the other. 
Overall it’s but not good enough. 
 I’d have to say this app may not be for me.

You can’t include another Polarsteps member on your trip, so they get no notification of likes or comments. Manual check up only for them!

And somehow, when you arrive at a location, you have to have all your comments and photos you are yet to take ready to go. Because if you add them after, no one will get notified. 

Or, you could just check in to a spot when you’re actually leaving it. But don’t expect to be able to change your arrival time to the correct time and date, that’s locked. 

Back to expecting people to manually check stuff. Which really defeats the purpose of the whole app. Just set up a group in WhatsApp, would be much easier. And more accurate.

content: I have used this app for two other trips and am now using it again. I love it for my first two trips and have recommended it to many people but this trip is less than perfect. In another spot, it takes a direct route to the next destination instead of the route I have taken - I have turned on the tracker so it should have worked but in remote areas of Australia, it is not always the case. For these instances, I think it would be good if you were able to override/move the ‘road’ you have not taken, manually. I have tried to add places to add the road I actually took with appropriate times and dates, but it still is not playing the game. Am getting fairly frustrated with it.
